about: Fire data DE and WFCD lack (G10), each row from a saved wiki page. `exclude` keeps a gun out with a reason until real values are known. `no_reload`: shots come straight from the ammo pool, no reload between shots. `beam_ramp_start`: beam damage at the start of the 0.6 s ramp-up (HELD guns only); `defaults` applies to every beam without its own row. Forced procs, burst count/delay and Lanka's no-delay rule come from the wiki weapon data modules, not from here.
